title: Containers and Container Platforms
description: Learn Docker, ACR, Container Apps, and AKS for deploying containerized applications on Azure.
longDescription: This module covers container development and deployment on Azure. You will learn how to build container images, store them in ACR, deploy with Container Apps or AKS, configure ingress and scaling, and choose the right container platform for your workload.
whatYouLearn: Build optimized container images with Docker
Push and manage images in Azure Container Registry
Deploy containerized apps with Azure Container Apps
Compare Container Apps, AKS, and App Service
